description: Own title bar may drag, minimize and close the window; Twitch, autostart (own Run entry), usage, PC status (incl. closing a program named in a warning), popouts (the app hands a notice to the popout window, flyout.rs), what plays according to Windows (read-only, media.rs), read-only device battery commands and opening soundcloud.com links and writing the settings export to Downloads and a copy of the settings next to the Twitch settings run in Rust; RAM cleaning asks Windows for administrator rights each time; the online backup stores settings encrypted in the web content at dpaste.com or catbox.moe and fetches them by move code; the reset helper lists installed programs and installs chosen programs of a fixed list on click, downloaded from the makers and started only with a valid signature of the expected maker; the gaming optimisation changes a fixed list of per-user Windows settings on click and restores them from its own backup; updates only come from the app's own GitHub releases and are installed on click. No filesystem, shell, HTTP, or hardware permissions for the frontend.
